raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: 0.12.0

package:
  name: tmtoolkit
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/t/tmtoolkit/tmtoolkit-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 6df5429cd675989f21d9f075ddb11fe5ae273d6544fc337a2589bab2bc331909

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python =${{ python_min }}
    - setuptools
  run:
    - bidict
    - globre
    - matplotlib-base
    - numpy <2.0
    - openpyxl
    - pandas
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - scipy
    - wheel
    - xlrd

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - tmtoolkit
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python =${{ python_min }}
    script:
      - pip check

about:
  summary: Text Mining and Topic Modeling Toolkit
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/internaut/tmtoolkit
  repository: https://github.com/internaut/tmtoolkit

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - danielnachun
